title: The Value of Wisdom

questions.question: If you receive my words and treasure up my what with you?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:1 (ESV): "My son, if you receive my words and treasure up my commandments with you,"

questions.question: For the Lord gives what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:6 (ESV): "For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding;"

questions.question: He stores up sound wisdom for whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:7 (ESV): "he stores up sound wisdom for the upright;"

questions.question: Wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:10 (ESV): "for wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul;"

questions.question: Discretion will watch over you, understanding will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:11 (ESV): "discretion will watch over you, understanding will guard you,"

questions.question: Delivering you from the way of evil, from men of perverted what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:12 (ESV): "delivering you from the way of evil, from men of perverted speech,"

questions.question: Who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:13 (ESV): "who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,"

questions.question: So you will be delivered from the forbidden woman, from the adulteress with her smooth what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:16 (ESV): "So you will be delivered from the forbidden woman, from the adulteress with her smooth words,"

questions.question: For her house sinks down to death, and her paths to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:18 (ESV): "for her house sinks down to death, and her paths to the departed;"

questions.question: The upright will inhabit the land, and those with integrity will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:21 (ESV): "For the upright will inhabit the land, and those with integrity will remain in it,"

questions.question: If you seek it like silver and search for it as for what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:4 (ESV): "if you seek it like silver and search for it as for hidden treasures,"

questions.question: Then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:5 (ESV): "then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God."

questions.question: He is a shield to those who walk in what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:7 (ESV): "...he is a shield to those who walk in integrity,"

questions.question: None who go to her come back, nor do they regain the paths of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:19 (ESV): "none who go to her come back, nor do they regain the paths of life."

questions.question: The wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 2:22 (ESV): "but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be rooted out of it."

key_verse_text: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding;
